summary: Craze & Crash, Saturday policy night: found YouTube's YPP overhaul (from 1 Feb 2027) and told the owner, added 3 Short topics (Timberland founder story, the BowFlex home-gym boom and bust, Ronco's $56M to $6.5M fall), and flagged that upload slot, not story, explains most of the views gap.
why: core_needed was true (founder_bet): Timberland has 199K views on its own idea (10x). Nautilus and Ronco are tonight's only on-niche breakouts in the 27 Nov market feed (53.7K on 114 subs, 31.6K on 54 subs). 48 h views at 17:47 IST were 1,137/203/1,373/1,537 against 12/51/1,214/71 at 22:17 IST.

findings.title: YPP bar rises on 1 Feb 2027
findings.detail: New applicants: 8,000 watch hours in 365 days or 20M Shorts views in 90 days. Shorts revenue only with 10M Shorts views in 90 days. Long videos are this channel's route.

findings.title: The 22:17 IST slot trails the 17:47 slot
findings.detail: 4 Shorts a slot; founder_bet mostly went out at 22:17, so its 0.28x in evaluate is mixed up with the hour. Proposal slot-story-confound.

findings.title: Nautilus sold $552.6M in 2020, BowFlex went for $37.5M in 2024
findings.detail: A home-gym craze in two figures, for product_craze_short.

findings.title: Ronco: about $56M in 2005, about $6.5M at auction in 2007
